notes.text: The page introduces a tree Gamma=(S,A,R), vertices S, edges A and the incidence relation. The bracketed remark contains A into P_2(S) and S to P(A), then an injectivity statement with the drawn two-vertex one-edge graph as its stated exception. The visibly decorated left end of the second arrow remains uncertain.

The author introduces families U_s and E_a and defines X by their two displayed disjoint unions. The graph is reproduced as two filled vertices and one edge without arrowheads. There are no additional figure labels.

The text cuts the tree at a_0, names Gamma prime and Gamma double-prime, gives a binary decomposition, and writes separate coproduct formulas for X prime and X double-prime. The second lower edge index visibly has an open c-shaped form; the summand remains E_a. The following connective is avec and the intersection is written E_{a_0}.

The lower text calls the decomposition propre and writes two inequalities. The first smallest index has an ascending b-like stroke, which is retained with 0 as an alternative. The next prose sentence and the final parenthesized criterion concern sommet-bout and U_s nonempty. Both equivalence abbreviations are visibly sss. No mathematical correction was introduced.

The parallel indices and repeated a_0 were considered as reading cues only. They did not decide the open c|a in the second coproduct or b|0 in the first inequality. The graph and injectivity prose did not decide the overwritten second arrow. No proof, independent re-proof or computation was performed.

No title, date, authorial question mark or explicit check instruction is visible. The number 27 is in faint pencil at the lower left and is retained as an archive sheet-number comment. H's note about A prime and A double-prime is editorial text without a manuscript counterpart.
